public_statistical_note.status: The following longer note is retained as an internal earlier draft, not a required public appendix. Superseded for publication by the compact seven-language8.3 candidates requested by root.
public_statistical_note.zh: 统计说明（编辑复核）：本表按世界田联官方历届结果与回溯确认的世界纪录进程重建，不冒充原稿已经提供的一份研究数据。截止2025年东京世锦赛；奥运计至2024年巴黎。奥运男1500、5000、10000均自1912年起，女项分别自1972、1996、1988年起；世锦赛男三项与女1500自1983年，女5000自1995年，女10000自1987年起。仅正式成年室外决赛；女3000前身、1980年女10000表演赛、预赛和半决赛不计。男1500在1912年前已有奥运决赛，本表明确不计。七场按今天回溯表统计，并非当时曾获批准的所有纪录：科勒迈宁1912年奥运万米31:20.8曾先获批，后来布安1911年30:58.8的日期获更正，今天进程表不再把前者列作纪录。这里的7/225只描述该范围，不能单独比较专门纪录赛的逐场破纪录率。
public_statistical_note.en: Statistical note (editorial reconstruction): This count was rebuilt from World Athletics' official historical results and retrospective record progressions; it is not presented as an original research dataset supplied with the manuscript. The cutoff is Tokyo2025 for Worlds and Paris2024 for Olympics. Olympic men's1500/5000/10000 are counted from1912; women's1500/5000/10000 from1972/1996/1988. World Championship men's three events and women's1500 start1983, women's5000 in1995 and women's10000 in1987. Only official senior outdoor finals are counted, excluding the women's3000 predecessor,1980women's10000exhibition,heats and semifinals. Men's Olympic1500finals before1912 are deliberately excluded. The seven follow today's retrospective lists, not every historical ratification: Kolehmainen's1912Olympic10000of31:20.8 was initially ratified, but Bouin's faster30:58.8 was subsequently placed in1911, leaving the Olympic mark out of the current progression. The7/225 proportion cannot alone compare the per-race record rate with dedicated record attempts.
